tools.name: get_work
tools.description: Details of one keyboard work in the Klavierstuck catalogue, by its slug: composer, catalogue references (Op., BWV, K., S.…), key, composition and publication dates, duration, instrument, performing forces, sub-genres, era, difficulty ratings with their scale, child works in order (e.g. the pieces of

tools.name: search_works
tools.description: Search the Klavierstuck catalogue of classical keyboard works, like the site's Works page. Combine free text (title words or a catalogue reference such as "BWV 846" or "Op. 28") with filters given in plain words: composer, key, sub-genre, instrument, performing forces, and a difficulty range on one

tools.name: list_composers
tools.description: Composers in the Klavierstuck catalogue with their dates, slug and klavierstuck.org URL. Optional query filters by name (accents and case ignored). Use a slug with get_composer.

tools.name: get_composer
tools.description: One composer by slug: dates, portrait, catalogues (with chapters), stylistic movements with their work counts, and a summary of the works: counts by sub-genre and the top-level works (first 100) with their number of child works. Use search_works with the composer's name to page through every work.

tools.name: get_catalog
tools.description: One catalogue of a composer's works (Op., BWV, K., S., KK…) by slug: its chapters and its works in catalogue order, with key, date and difficulty ratings. Paged: 50 entries per page by default, at most 100. get_composer lists a composer's catalogues and their URLs (the slug is the last part).

tools.name: list_difficulty_scales
tools.description: The difficulty scales used for works' levels (Piano Syllabus 0–10, RCM, ABRSM, AMEB, PianoLibrary…): range, step and diploma levels above the numbered grades. Use a scale name and levels with search_works.

tools.name: list_eras_and_movements
tools.description: Eras of music history with their years (Baroque, Classicism, Romanticism…) and the stylistic movements in each, with a description, the number of composers in the catalogue and the klavierstuck.org URL.
